s.note: the tuk-tuk chase through the streets of Tangier
s.how: Mix 500g lamb mince with a grated onion, a teaspoon of cumin, chopped parsley and salt. Shape around skewers and grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Stir a spoon of harissa through Greek yoghurt and serve as a dip.

s.note: diving for the dial in the Aegean Sea with Renaldo
s.how: Marinate 600g baby octopus in olive oil, lemon juice and oregano for an hour. Grill on a very hot plate for 2 to 3 minutes until charred and just tender. Pile onto a plate, scatter with capers and serve with lemon wedges.

m.note: the Moroccan leg of the hunt
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften a sliced onion with grated ginger and a pinch of saffron. Add 500ml water, chopped preserved lemon and a handful of green olives. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until tender. Serve over fluffy couscous.

w.how: Blend 200g ground almonds with 800ml water and 150g sugar, stand 30 minutes and strain well. Add 1 tsp almond extract and freeze in a tray, scraping every 40 minutes for 3 hours. Serve in glasses with brioche.

d.how: Put 2 tbsp green tea leaves and a big bunch of fresh mint into a teapot with sugar to taste. Pour over a litre of just-boiled water and steep for 4 minutes. Pour from a height into small glasses so it froths, then pour back and pour again.
